provenance: Unit, sign, vertical component and year range supplied by user; absent from TIFF tags.
notes: Every finite valid pixel is exported once at its centre; zero values are retained; NaN/NoData/Inf are excluded.
Signed source displacements are preserved. Positive means subsidence magnitude for the user-confirmed declaration.
No annual time series is reconstructed. Division by declared duration only yields a period-average rate.
Start/end days and months are not supplied. Calendar-year windows are nominal and time alignment remains approximate.
sign_confirmation: User confirmed after checking the nonnegative TIFF statistics: positive values are the magnitude of cumulative subsidence.
